def recursive_function(n, memo={}):
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    if n <= 11:
        return min(n, 2 + (11 - n))
    base = 1
    count = 1
    while base <= n:
        base = base * 10 + 1
        count += 1
    limit = base // 10
    if base > 2 * n:
        times = n // limit
        rem = n % limit
        option1 = recursive_function(base - n, memo) + count
        option2 = times * (count - 1) + recursive_function(rem, memo)
        memo[n] = min(option1, option2)
        return memo[n]
    else:
        times = n // limit
        rem = n % limit
        option1 = recursive_function(base - n, memo) + count
        option2 = times * (count - 1) + recursive_function(rem, memo)
        memo[n] = min(option1, option2)
        return memo[n]
